topic: Portfolio optimisation methods for combining a few trading strategies
headline: 2 of 6 methods hold up after costs in out-of-sample studies: covariance shrinkage and capped minimum variance.
could_test: Shrinkage against the sample covariance on the live book, with costs.
Minimum variance with a 30% cap per strategy against equal weights.
gaps: CVaR untested on real strategy returns

assumptions.question: Which market?
assumptions.assumed: Books of trading strategies in any liquid market.

assumptions.question: How deep?
assumptions.assumed: One row per method, no replication.
